messages:
maria: Heads up — started seeing a wave of pod preemptions in gpu-spot-us-west-2 about 20m ago. Lots of 1GPU training jobs getting kicked in the same AZ. Any ideas?

sched-bot: :alert: 1787654330 [ALERT] 67 pods preempted in last 10m on nodes labeled az=us-west-2b. Sample eviction reason: "insufficient gpu (fragmented)". Example: kubectl describe pod training-12 -> Node had 2 free gpus but split across nodes.

derek: Sounds like the zone-spread change we rolled last week is scattering small gpu pods across AZs. Spreading + mixed instance sizes = fragmentation.

elaine: Confirmed on my end. Top offending nodes are g5x-4 and g5x-8 with 1-2 idle GPUs each. Small jobs reserve 1GPU but scheduler prefers spreading, so we end up with lots of half-empty nodes.

carlos: Customers are seeing retries/429s. We should do a fast mitigation.

derek: Short-term options: revert the hard requiredDuringSchedulingDuringExecution topologySpread to prefer, or change the spread scope to rack instead of AZ. Either reduces the scatter.

maria: Could we flip a flag to tell scheduler to pack 1GPU pods into fewer nodes temporarily? :thinking_face:

elaine: Two quick routes: 1) Add a lightweight preferAffinity for pods labeled small-gpu to co-locate. 2) Run the descheduler to evict low-priority pods and let scheduler re-pack them.

derek: I'd also propose a mutating webhook that tags pods with requests.gpu==1 as small-gpu=true so we can apply affinity without changing customer manifests.

carlos: Also consider lowering the preemption priority of some best-effort batch jobs so they get evicted instead of lots of 1GPU jobs.

maria: Long-term fix is improving scoring: enable preferBinPacking scoring and increase weight for gpu in resource scoring, e.g. resourceWeights: { gpu: 1000, cpu: 1 }. Makes scheduler favor filling GPUs.

elaine: For a hotfix I can run a descheduler job targeting BestEffort and Burstable pods on nodes with <50% gpu-util. That should free contiguous GPUs to place pending pods.

# quick mutating webhook idea (pseudo)
```
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
# match pods where requests.nvidia.com/gpu == 1 -> add label small-gpu=true
# then use preferredDuringScheduling podAffinity to pack these onto nodes with other small-gpu pods
```

derek: I'll spin up a canary scheduler config in staging with PodTopologySpread set to prefer + enable the BinPacking score plugin. Will test with a synthetic workload.

carlos: Finance note — packing will increase instance utilization and reduce spot churn, so cost should improve. But there may be a short-term blip while we rebalance.

maria: Action items: Derek drafts scheduler patch and canary (ETA 15m), Elaine kicks the descheduler job (started now), Carlos adjusts client retry backoffs to avoid tight retry loops. I'll monitor metrics (gpu_preemptions, pod_scheduling_latency).

sched-bot: 1787654350 descheduler job "fragment-cleanup" started by elaine on cluster-prod (target: best-effort pods, nodes: az=us-west-2b).

oncall-bot: Paging @derek @carlos — please ack in #oncall. Linked incident #INC-4032.

derek: Ack — will push canary and report results. Keeping change as prefer, not required.

elaine: If the canary looks good we'll roll to remaining AZs. If things get worse we can cordon smaller instance types (g5x-4) temporarily to force consolidation.

maria: Update 1787654385: descheduler freed 18 1GPU best-effort pods, scheduler placed 12 pending jobs onto 4 nodes (gpu util increased from 21% -> 68% on those nodes). Preemptions trending down. I'll post charts in ~10m.

derek: Good signal. Will proceed with cautious rollout.

maria: Thanks team. I'll keep watching and reopen if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
